verdict.rationale: Parsec documents its own stylus forwarding: "Full Wacom tablet support with pressure + tilt", with the Wacom tablet able to "go anywhere you want." This covers stylus input on a (pen) tablet reaching the host. An Android client is listed, but nothing shows phone or tablet touchscreen input being mapped to host pointer events. Missing for 10: touch-input mapping on phone or tablet clients, stylus support on mobile devices (as opposed to Wacom hardware), documentation of how gestures map to host pointer events, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, touch and stylus input on a tablet or phone maps to pointer events on the host

citations.quote: Full Wacom tablet support with pressure + tilt
Your controllers, Wacom tablet, software, and monitors can now go anywhere you want.
